title: Big Daddy
recommended: MASTER • 11★ • 974 notes • 20 SPACE • Song choreography v17.4.44

direction_profile.notes: All note directions were re-authored from a per-song movement grammar. FLAC-derived timing, note types, Reverse placement, SPACE timing, and note counts are unchanged.
direction_profile.readability_note: No retained direction was changed. Only telemetry-confirmed failure slots were removed.

chart_design.version: 17.4.18 Big Daddy MASTER telemetry rebalance pass 2
chart_design.principle: Lossless-source onset evidence selects subdivisions; phrase energy controls density; calm sections keep breathing room and payoff sections escalate.
chart_design.timing_rule: Verified BPM grid with FLAC-driven phase refinement; no free-running timestamp drift.
chart_design.difficulty_rule: MASTER remains clearly above HARD through higher average density, more Reverse pressure, denser half-second bursts, and less recovery, but no section should become an unreadable sustained wall.
chart_design.reverse_rule: Reverse stays a major MASTER pressure source, but 26 Reverse notes inside telemetry-confirmed failure peaks are removed so special-note load does not stack excessively on top of sustained dense streams.
chart_design.readability_rule: Telemetry-confirmed collapse windows are thinned selectively. Retained timestamps and directions are unchanged; 20 SPACE events remain untouched. Dense 79 ms bursts are preserved selectively so MASTER keeps its identity while longer 158 ms streams gain micro-recovery.
chart_design.direction_rule: Each song owns a deterministic movement grammar derived from its FLAC-timing rhythm fingerprint and section form. No global fixed direction motif bank or cyclic motif index is used.
chart_design.direction_guardrails: No same-direction spam, no immediate repeated 2–12-note blocks, no 4+ clockwise/counter-clockwise perimeter walks, and no three-step repeated translation vector.

difficulty_standardization.policy: Smooth only telemetry-confirmed cliff slots that are ordinary notes. Preserve all MASTER Reverse and SPACE events and sustained pressure streams.

telemetry_master_rebalance.observed_issue: Repeated unreadable MISS chains and reaction/readability collapse concentrated in high-density windows rather than uniform difficulty.
telemetry_master_rebalance.policy: Remove only selected telemetry-confirmed failure slots, prioritize micro-recovery in sustained <=160 ms streams, preserve enough 79 ms burst language to keep MASTER distinct from HARD.
